statement.text: For any positive integers $k,d$, the maximal $k$-rank $\operatorname{rk}^{\max}_k(kd,2)$ of binary forms equals $k$. Additionally, in the above notation, binary forms representable by $\ell_1 \ell_2^{kd-1}$, where $\ell_1$ and $\ell_2$ are non-proportional linear forms, have the latter maximal $k$-rank.

title: Algebraic Stories — Maximal $k$-rank
